title: Q: what will the prelim ask
persona: CS 3410 student, Prelim 1 is Thursday. You want to study truncation and sign extension the way it will actually be tested: ask 'what kind of problems will the prelim ask me on this?', then 'teach me how to solve those', then do a couple of similar problems (make one sign-extension slip). You trust real practice-prelim problems more than made-up ones.
lines: hey, I want to prep truncation and sign extension for the prelim
